description: This file defines configuration settings for push notification builds, including enums for transport modes, distribution modes, and APNs environments, as well as a struct that reads these settings from an app bundle and provides utility methods.

classes.name: PushBuildConfig
classes.description: A struct that encapsulates push notification build configuration, reading values from the app bundle and providing convenient accessors.

methods.name: init(bundle:)
methods.description: Initializer that loads configuration values from the provided bundle, with defaults.

methods.name: usesRelay
methods.description: Computed property indicating whether the transport mode is relay.

methods.name: readURL(bundle:key:)
methods.description: Reads and validates a URL string from the bundle, ensuring it uses HTTPS and has no user info or query parameters.

methods.name: readEnum(bundle:key:fallback:)
methods.description: Reads a string value from the bundle and converts it into a RawRepresentable enum, or returns a fallback.
